description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath inaugurated IBM's 'AI GovTech Innovation Center' in Lucknow, aimed at integrating AI into governance to enhance service delivery and productivity. The center will also introduce AI literacy programs for students and collaborate with IIT Kanpur for scalable solutions in the state.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh CM Adityanath inaugurates IBM’s ‘AI GovTech Innovation Center’ in Lucknow The Center will serve as a collaborative platform to design, validate and scale trusted AI solutions that enhance productivity, transparency and service delivery, with models built for replication and broader adoption, said IBM in a statement. NEW DELHI: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Sunday inaugurated the American multinational IBM’s “AI GovTech Innovation Center” in Lucknow, which will focus on integrating artificial intelligence in governance.
